rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for connecting one thing with another in your mind or imagination.

example.english: I associate the color red with a warning.
example.traditional: 我一見到紅色就聯想到警告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou3 hung4 sik1 zau6 lyun4 soeng2 dou3 ging2 gou3

rows.note: Use this for physically or conceptually joining or combining things.

example.english: We need to associate the two plans with each other to get the best result.
example.traditional: 我哋將兩個方案結合埋一齊，先至做到最理想嘅效果。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 loeng5 go3 fong1 on3 git3 hap6 maai4 jat1 cai4 sin1 zi3 zou6 dou2 zeoi3 lei5 soeng2 ge3 haau6 gwo2

rows.note: Use this for spending time with people or maintaining social contact with them.

example.english: I associate with my neighbors regularly.
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 tung4 gaai1 fong1 loi4 wong5

rows.note: Use this when people actively join forces as partners or allies, rather than merely socializing.

example.english: The two companies associate with each other to organize a charity event.
example.traditional: 兩間公司聯手搞慈善活動。
example.jyutping: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 lyun4 sau2 gaau2 ci4 sin6 wut6 dung6
